Business Jalwa kyun bana? 🤔

Business ki baatein aksar complicated terms mein samjhayi jaati hain. Is page par hum finance aur business terms ko simple Hinglish aur easy examples ke saath samjhenge.

Pehle Revenue, Profit, ROE aur P/E jaise basics. Phir real Company Stories—company kya karti hai, paisa kaise kamati hai, aur kahan-kahan kaam karti hai.

Aap kis company ki story dekhna chahoge? Comment karke batao! 🏢

#BusinessJalwa #BusinessBasics #CompanyStories #BusinessInHinglish

Business kya hai? 🤔

Simple words mein: Jab koi customer ki zaroorat ya problem solve karta hai aur badle mein paisa kamata hai, woh business hai.

Pehle business aksar mohalla tak hota tha. Aaj internet aur delivery se naye shehron ke customers tak pahunchna possible hai. Tareeka badla hai, par core wahi hai: customer ko value dena.

Agli post: Company paisa kaise kamati hai? 🏢

#BusinessJalwa #BusinessBasics #BusinessInHinglish #IndianBusiness #Entrepreneurship

Revenue kya hota hai? 🧾

Business ki products ya services ki total sales income ko revenue kehte hain—expenses ghataane se pehle.

Example: 100 tiffin × ₹80 = ₹8,000 revenue.

Agli post: Business expenses.

#BusinessJalwa #BusinessBasics #Revenue #BusinessInHinglish

Business expenses kya hote hain? 💸

Business chalane ke liye jo paisa kharch hota hai, woh expense hai. Rent jaise costs fixed ho sakte hain; ingredients jaise costs sales ke saath badal sakte hain.

Dono ko track karna pricing aur profit samajhne mein help karta hai.

Agli post: Revenue vs Profit.

#BusinessJalwa #BusinessBasics #BusinessExpenses #BusinessInHinglish

Revenue aur profit same nahi hote. 📊

Revenue = total sales income. Profit = revenue mein se expenses ghataane ke baad bacha paisa.

Example: ₹8,000 revenue − ₹6,500 expenses = ₹1,500 profit (tax se pehle).

Agli post: Profit Margin.

#BusinessJalwa #Revenue #Profit #BusinessInHinglish

Profit margin batata hai ki revenue ka kitna hissa profit bana. 📈

Formula: Net Profit ÷ Revenue × 100

Example: ₹10,000 revenue aur ₹1,000 net profit = 10% margin.

Industry ke hisaab se margins alag ho sakte hain.

Agli post: Cash Flow.

#BusinessJalwa #ProfitMargin #BusinessBasics #BusinessInHinglish

Cash flow ka matlab business mein cash aane aur bahar jaane ka movement. 💰

Profit dikh raha ho tab bhi payment late aane se cash ki kami ho sakti hai. Example: invoice aaj bana, customer 30 din baad pay kare.

Isliye timing bhi track karo.

Agli post: Business Model.

#BusinessJalwa #CashFlow #BusinessBasics #BusinessInHinglish

Business model batata hai business customer ko kya value deta hai aur usse paisa kaise kamata hai. 🧩

Socho: customer kaun hai, uski need kya hai, aur payment kis cheez ke liye aati hai?

Agli post: Revenue Streams.

#BusinessJalwa #BusinessModel #BusinessBasics #BusinessInHinglish

Revenue stream = business mein paisa aane ka ek source. 🌊

Examples: product sales, subscription, service fees, ya commission. Ek business ke multiple revenue streams ho sakte hain.

Agli post: ROE ko simple example se samjhenge.

#BusinessJalwa #RevenueStreams #BusinessBasics #BusinessInHinglish

ROE yani Return on Equity. 📊

Ye batata hai company shareholders ki equity ke muqable kitna profit kama rahi hai.

Formula: Net Profit ÷ Average Shareholders’ Equity × 100

ROE ko same industry ki companies aur multiple years ke context mein dekho; high ROE akela poori picture nahi batata.

Agli post: P/E Ratio.

#BusinessJalwa #ROE #FinanceTerms #BusinessInHinglish

P/E yani Price-to-Earnings ratio. 📈

Formula: Share price ÷ Earnings Per Share (EPS)

Example: ₹200 share price ÷ ₹10 EPS = P/E 20. Matlab share price annual EPS ka 20 guna hai.

High P/E automatic good ya bad nahi—similar companies, growth aur profits ke saath compare karo. Ye akela buy/sell signal nahi hai.
